# Finn: Swim & Snorkel Buddy

> Finn is a free app for Apple Watch and iPhone. A pixel animal swims with you on your wrist while you swim or snorkel, your swims are saved to a logbook, and after ten minutes in the water someone new might turn up and join your aquarium. It has no account and no server. It is for fun and is not a dive computer. Depth and water temperature need an Apple Watch Ultra or a Series 10 or later.

## App

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824734537): Finn: Swim & Snorkel Buddy
